subject: T-0183 (81dc58f) + T-0220 (dbdd04e) on disk; 44/44 green; one question on T-0181's read cursor
body:
Two commits. T-0183 also needed a scroll epoch (the existing anchor test was intermittent 1-in-5 for that reason, found by instrumenting rather than re-running). T-0220 had a third mechanism: v-model on a computed, so the tab click was dropped silently. Falsified both against the unfixed source.

Question blocking T-0181 part 2: the read cursor (aim read --as human --channel hello --through <id>) is a new verb in bin/aim and a new event in the channel chain. Your card, your call: (a) now, (b) file separately, or (c) skip it and I land the part that needs no new state today. Full reasoning in the hello channel note.
